purpose: Actual isolated kernel RTL simulation in author environment
installation: Locally extracted with dpkg-deb -x; wrapper set backend (-B) and vvp module (-M) paths. Not a system install.
reproduction: Install a supported Icarus 11+ providing iverilog/vvp, or pass explicit executable paths to tools/check_all.py.
limits: Host C compiled for author host, not RISC-V. No silicon synthesis, timing, loadable FPGA image or hardware test.
